definitions.explanation: Operating or functioning without human personnel. Used for automated systems, machines, and facilities that do not require human operators.
Having no people living there. Used for islands, buildings, or areas with no inhabitants.

examples.japanese: {無人|むじん}{販売所|はんばいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy vegetables at an unmanned stand.

examples.japanese: {無人|むじん}⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦ドローン→ドローン：06097_doroon⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無人|むじん}{航空機|こうくうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Regulations on unmanned aircraft such as drones are being tightened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無人島|むじんとう}→無人島：16950_mujintou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I was washed ashore on an uninhabited island.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無人|むじん}になった。
⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{無人|むじん}になった⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いくつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Depopulation has advanced, and many deserted houses stand in a row.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before nouns: {無人|むじん} + noun. In modern Japanese, sense 1 (unmanned/automated) is increasingly common due to the spread of automation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{無人島|むじんとう}→無人島：16950_mujintou⟧: uninhabited island
- {無人|むじん}{駅|えき}: unmanned station
- {無人|むじん}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: unmanned sales (honor-system stands)
- {無人|むじん}⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧: self-checkout
- {無人|むじん}{航空機|こうくうき}: unmanned aircraft, drone
